setup.title: Welcome to LifeStash
setup.description: Set up your private stash. Sign in with email and password, or with a passkey (fingerprint, face or device PIN).

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your email and password, or with a passkey.
login.useRecovery: Can't sign in? Use a recovery code

recover.title: Use a recovery code
recover.description: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each code works once.
recover.success: Signed in. Add a new passkey in Settings so you're not locked out next time.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.description: If you lose every device with your passkey, these codes are the only way back in. Store them somewhere safe — each one works once.

errors.failed: Couldn't verify the passkey. Please try again.
errors.invalidCode: That recovery code isn't valid or was already used.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.

signOutDescription: You'll need to sign in again on this device.
